items.title: How much startup validation coverage it takes to close L1's exact gap
items.description: Grounded in L1's Scenario: a service typically has a handful of config values that legitimately differ between staging and production (a timeout, an API key, a rate limit, a feature flag...), and each one carries some small chance of an accidental mistake like the missing PAYMENT_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT_MS. With zero automated startup validation, any of those mistakes reaches production undetected. Drag validation coverage up to see how much of that risk a fail-fast validator actually removes.

params.name: differingValues
params.label: Config values that differ between staging and prod

params.name: mistakeRatePercent
params.label: Chance any single value has an accidental mistake

items.compute: const uncoveredValues = params.differingValues * (1 - params.validationCoveragePercent / 100); const mistakeRate = params.mistakeRatePercent / 100; const probabilityMistakeReachesProd = Math.round((1 - Math.pow(1 - mistakeRate, uncoveredValues)) * 1000) / 10; return { probabilityMistakeReachesProd };

outputs.label: Chance at least one silent misconfiguration reaches production
